text: Source: "Multispectral Laboratory of Optical Analysis Methods", Table 1, page 6 (file S01).
Transcribed from the rendered page because PDF text extraction interleaves the columns.
"mu" in the original means micrometres; written here as "um".
Merged cells of the original are expanded, so each row is independent.
sensitivity / selectivity / cost are the original qualitative ratings (low / average / high), not measured values.
"ATR probe*" carries an asterisk in the original; no footnote is printed on that page.
Status: transcription for AFS review. Ratings are the source document's, not an AFS product specification.
